reason: The plugin is an agent-focused browser automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding MCP tools to start and control browser sessions and manage profiles/proxies. Its primary purpose is operational workflow automation (navigation, interaction, content extraction, screenshots) with optional identity-oriented browser settings, rather than code generation or analysis of repository contents.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，通过 MCP 工具向模型提供可控制的浏览器会话，支持配置文件和代理管理，并可执行页面导航、点击、填写、脚本执行与截图等自动化操作。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides MCP-controlled browser sessions, with profile and proxy management plus page automation actions such as navigation, click, fill, evaluate, and screenshot.

capabilities: Web browser session orchestration via MCP tools for launch/close/list operations
Profile lifecycle management with persistent state handling across runs
Proxy listing/claiming and traffic routing capabilities
Page automation actions including navigation, clicking, input, script evaluation, content retrieval, and screenshots
Live session viewing and Android device-profile emulation support

reasons.code: README describes the project as a DeepSeek Harness plugin and lists tools for sessions, profiles, proxies, page control, and live view, showing core browser workflow automation.
Tool inventory in README includes `launch_browser`, `navigate`, `click`, `fill`, `evaluate`, `get_content`, `screenshot`, and `start_live_view`, indicating direct interaction with web pages.
README states persistent profiles with cookies/passkeys and per-profile settings are part of normal operation.
README and feature list mention anti-detect behavior, engine-level fingerprinting control, and residential proxy egress.
Package metadata and topics include `anti-detect-browser`, `browser-fingerprinting`, and `residential-proxy`, reflecting identity- and network-oriented automation capabilities.
